tasks.title: Build pipeline and six DG_TEST_ hooks (gate build)
tasks.instructions: Read tests/doom/ACCEPTANCE.md sections 2, 3 and 5 first. (1) Create platform/dg_test_hooks.c with exactly six getters exported via EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE: DG_TEST_GetGameTic (extern int gametic), DG_TEST_GetFrameCount (reads a platform frame counter incremented once per completed DG_DrawFrame; expose the counter from doomgeneric_wasm.c via an extern), DG_TEST_GetPlayerX, DG_TEST_GetPlayerY, DG_TEST_GetViewAngle (players[consoleplayer].mo->x/y/angle; return 0 when mo is NULL) and DG_TEST_GetAmmo (players[consoleplayer].ammo[weaponinfo[readyweapon].ammo], 0 for am_noammo). Getters only, no other DG_TEST_ symbol anywhere. (2) Write /build.sh at the repo root (bash, set -euo pipefail, cd to its own directory): rm -rf dist build; compile every needed engine .c from third_party/doomgeneric (inspect the directory and skip files for other platforms such as SDL/X11/Windows front ends and anything with its own main; keep dummy.c only if needed) plus platform/*.c with emcc (Emscripten 4.0.18, no network, no SharedArrayBuffer/threads, no MODULARIZE); output into build/ then copy to dist/doom/. Output must be doom.js + exactly one doom.wasm (+ doom.data from --preload-file of assets/doom1.wad as /doom1.wad if used) with ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH, and EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS naming the six hooks plus _main and whatever later tasks need (keep any non-hook helper exports named without the DG_TEST_ prefix). Use -sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS as needed. Never modify third_party or assets (read only); put needed shim headers or defines in platform/ or on the emcc command line. (3) Give doomgeneric_wasm.c a minimal compiling main() that calls doomgeneric_Create(argc, argv) so the link succeeds; the real loop comes in T2. (4) Emit a placeholder dist/doom/index.html copied from web/index.html so BUILD-01.c holds. Verify locally if emcc is available: bash build.sh exits 0, wasm validates, wasm exports list contains exactly the six DG_TEST_ names.
tasks.acceptance: Gate build: from a clean tree `bash build.sh` exits 0 offline; dist/doom/index.html and exactly one *.wasm exist; WebAssembly.validate is true; the wasm exports all six DG_TEST_GetGameTic/GetFrameCount/GetPlayerX/GetPlayerY/GetViewAngle/GetAmmo and no other DG_TEST_* name; emcc reports 4.0.18.

tasks.title: Boot E1M1 in browser, WAD packaging and subpath deploy (gates boot+m1)
tasks.instructions: Make the engine actually run in the page. Platform (platform/doomgeneric_wasm.c): DG_Init no-op; DG_GetTicksMs returns (uint32_t)emscripten_get_now() (real wall clock, never constant); DG_SleepMs must not block the browser for long (short bounded spin on emscripten_get_now is acceptable, since engine waits in d_loop.c TryRunTics and f_wipe are short; do NOT enable threads or require special headers; only use ASYNCIFY if spinning proves insufficient); DG_DrawFrame increments the frame counter and blits DG_ScreenBuffer (640x400, 32-bit) to canvas#canvas via an EM_JS/EM_ASM helper (a first working conversion into ImageData is enough; exact colour/alpha correctness is T3); DG_GetKey returns 0 for now; DG_SetWindowTitle sets document.title. main(): call doomgeneric_Create(argc, argv) then drive doomgeneric_Tick() from emscripten_set_main_loop(fn, 0, 0) (requestAnimationFrame) so each browser frame runs once and returns; catch fatal I_Error/exit by surfacing the message on the page rather than hanging. Web (web/): index.html with <canvas id="canvas" width=640 height=400>, loaded via relative URLs only (no leading slash) so it works under /doom/; a small script that sets the global `Module` (no MODULARIZE) BEFORE loading doom.js, with Module.canvas = the canvas and Module.arguments built from the query string: warp=E1M1 -> -warp 1 1 (also support EnM/ExMy generally), skill=N -> -skill N, nomonsters=1 -> -nomonsters; always pass -iwad doom1.wad. Without params the title/menu shows. Package assets/doom1.wad into the virtual FS (--preload-file in build.sh, produce doom.data next to doom.js) and make the engine find it as /doom1.wad; ensure writable cwd for default.cfg/savegames in MEMFS. build.sh must copy web/* into dist/doom/ (replace T1 placeholder). Serve with correct MIME for .wasm is the static server's job; just load wasm with relative path and use WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming-compatible output. Make sure no uncaught exceptions or rejections occur during the first seconds; pass console errors through but do not throw.
tasks.acceptance: Gate m1 (includes build+boot): page under a static server at /doom/ reaches GetGameTic()>0 within 20 s; canvas is not one uniform colour; no fatal error; with ?warp=E1M1&nomonsters=1 the player X/Y at first tic equal the E1M1 player-start THING from doom1.wad; no crashes/uncaught exceptions in the short stability run; wasm is served as application/wasm under /doom/ and LOAD-01/WAD-01 also hold under the subpath (all asset URLs relative).

tasks.title: Correct video output and steady 35 Hz timing with heartbeat (gates video+time)
tasks.instructions: Video: the engine framebuffer bytes in memory are B,G,R,0 (little endian, red at bit 16, see platform/README.md). Convert per pixel to R,G,B,255 for ImageData (swap B/R, force alpha 255 for every pixel, full 640x400) and putImageData each DG_DrawFrame; do this in JS over HEAPU8/HEAPU32 or in C into a staging buffer. Ensure the canvas stays 640x400 and is not scaled in ways that change backing store size. DG_TEST_GetFrameCount must rise only per completed DG_DrawFrame. Timing: the game must advance ~35 tics/s (accepted 26.25 to 43.75) measured as delta(GetGameTic)/delta(performance.now()) on both a 60 Hz and a throttled rAF; do not scale or fake time. Use real wall-clock DG_GetTicksMs (emscripten_get_now) so the engine's own I_GetTime-based tic generation sets the pace; the main loop must run doomgeneric_Tick once per rAF without any blocking longer than ~100 ms (check the wipe and TryRunTics waits; keep DG_SleepMs bounded). Heartbeat: requestAnimationFrame gaps must stay below 1000 ms and the page must stay responsive to an external evaluate during play (no long synchronous loops, no multi-second startup stalls after first tic). Tune EM linker flags in build.sh only if needed (e.g. INITIAL_MEMORY, -O2).
tasks.acceptance: Gate time (includes video): all canvas pixels have alpha 255; E1M1 regions match PLAYPAL/status-bar reference colours (no red/blue swap); GetFrameCount rises and canvas content changes while the player turns; tic rate over a 10 s window after 2 s warmup is within 26.25-43.75 tics/s; largest rAF gap <= 1000 ms; page answers an external watchdog while running; earlier gates (build, boot, m1) still pass.

tasks.title: Keyboard input: move, turn, fire, run, release, no page side effects (gate input)
tasks.instructions: Implement DG_GetKey with a fixed-size ring queue in C (platform/) of (pressed, doomkey) pairs fed by an exported non-DG_TEST_ function (e.g. dg_push_key(int pressed, int key), added to EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS in build.sh). In web/ add JS keydown/keyup listeners on window (document) mapping KeyboardEvent.code/key to doomkeys.h codes: ArrowUp->KEY_UPARROW, ArrowDown->KEY_DOWNARROW, ArrowLeft->KEY_LEFTARROW, ArrowRight->KEY_RIGHTARROW, Control (ControlLeft/Right)->KEY_FIRE, Shift->KEY_RSHIFT (run), Space->KEY_USE (' '), Enter->KEY_ENTER, Escape->KEY_ESCAPE, plus letters/digits/Tab/Backspace/F-keys that the menu and cheats use (ASCII lowercase for letters, check doomkeys.h and m_controls.c defaults). Ignore auto-repeat keydown (event.repeat). Call preventDefault on every mapped key (arrows, space, ctrl combos) so the page never scrolls; keep the page focused (tabindex on canvas, focus on load, no click needed for input); send a release for every currently held key on window blur and on visibilitychange hidden so keys do not stick. Keys must work without any prior click. Do not rely on mouse. Make key events reach the engine on the next Tick; DG_GetKey drains one event per call as doomgeneric expects. Do not add listeners that throw.
tasks.acceptance: Gate input (includes time and earlier): ArrowUp/Down change player position forward/back, ArrowLeft/Right change view angle, Control decrements ammo (fire), Shift+move covers more distance than walk; after keyup the motion stops as in held-key control; arrow/space keydown are default-prevented so page scrollY does not change; document focus kept; held keys release on window blur; no regressions in TIME/VIDEO/boot gates.

tasks.title: Web Audio sound effects from the WAD (gate audio)
tasks.instructions: Enable sampled sound effects with Web Audio, no external audio libs. Define FEATURE_SOUND via the emcc command line (-DFEATURE_SOUND) in build.sh (third_party must not be edited) and provide a stub SDL_mixer.h (and any other missing SDL header the sound includes pull in) under platform/ placed on the -I path so i_sound.c compiles; avoid linking SDL. In platform/ implement DG_sound_module (sound_devices registration: see i_sound.h and i_sound.c use of sound_module / music_module and snd_sfxdevice settings; make i_sound.c choose your module even without SDL, set sfx device defaults through command-line/config as needed) with Init, Shutdown, GetSfxLumpNum, Update, UpdateSoundParams, StartSound(sfxinfo, channel, vol, sep), StopSound, SoundIsPlaying, CacheSounds. Sound lumps are DMX format (header: 3, rate(u16), length(u32), 16 pad bytes, 8-bit unsigned samples, 16 pad bytes tail); read via W_CacheLumpNum, convert to Float32 and play through an AudioBufferSourceNode with GainNode/StereoPanner using an EM_JS bridge in a JS library or inline EM_JS in platform/. Provide a stub DG_music_module (silence; music is out of scope but must not crash or block). Create the AudioContext lazily (or at load) and resume() it on the first keydown/pointerdown (add to the web key handler without breaking T4 preventDefault behaviour); expose it so an `AudioContext` exists and state is 'running' after a key press. Ensure firing the pistol (Control) in E1M1 produces non-silent samples at the context destination. Keep audio failures non-fatal (try/catch inside JS, no uncaught exceptions). Keep tic rate and heartbeat unaffected: decode samples lazily and cache by lump.
tasks.acceptance: Gate audio (includes input, time, video, m1): after a key press an AudioContext exists and state is running; after firing, non-silent audio reaches the output; no uncaught exceptions or unhandled rejections; TIME-01/02, INPUT-*, VIDEO-01 and boot/m1 still pass; wasm still exports only the six DG_TEST_ hooks as DG_TEST_ names.

notes: Roles fixed per feedback: coder_role values are from {integrator, wasm_platform, web_frontend}; T1 uses wasm_platform (platform + build.sh only), the rest use integrator because they span platform C and web JS. Five tasks (<=6), in gate order: build -> boot+m1 -> video+time -> input -> audio; gate final is run by the controller afterwards (no task has profile final). T1 and any later edit to build.sh or dg_test_hooks.c trigger flagged review. Key risks: engine waits in d_loop.c/f_wipe must not block rAF (keep DG_SleepMs bounded, avoid threads/SharedArrayBuffer); framebuffer is B,G,R,0 so needs alpha=255 and channel swap; WAD must be preloaded and all URLs relative for /doom/ subpath; hook exports must be exactly six DG_TEST_ names. 60 s soak and negative controls are verified by final only; music is intentionally out of scope.
